summary: Backend state regression passed. Browser testing passed attendance history with actual session duration, review queue navigation, assignment create/edit/delete with cancellable in-app confirmation, student/subject delete cancellation, and no frontend runtime errors. Duplicate Student ID validation failed; student and subject deletes still use native confirmations rather than in-app confirmations.

integration_issues.flow: Add student with duplicate Student ID
integration_issues.issue: A new student using existing ID ST-001 is saved and displayed alongside the existing ST-001 record; no rejection or warning is shown.
Both delete actions invoke browser-native window.confirm dialogs, not clear in-app confirmation UI as required. They are cancellable, but the UX is inconsistent with the assignment delete flow.

integration_issues.flow: Calendar add/edit then navigate away and back
integration_issues.issue: CalendarV2 keeps sessions in component-local state after PUT; prior iteration reproduced newly added/edited sessions disappearing after calendar remount. This remains present in the implementation.

action_items: Add client-side duplicate Student ID validation with clear inline feedback and block save.
Replace native student/subject window.confirm with the same cancellable in-app confirmation pattern used for assignments.
Synchronize CalendarV2 saves into shared App state so changes survive navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentsV2.commit() only checks names and never checks studentId uniqueness.
Student and subject delete handlers call window.confirm, violating the requested in-app confirmation UX.
App.js contains duplicate legacy and V2 components and CalendarV2 maintains a stale local sessions copy, increasing regression risk.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary absent attendance, duplicate student, and assignment records during browser testing; temporary duplicate and assignment records were removed through the state API. Existing attendance test record was retained as part of the current workspace state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified public state API and browser flows for review queue, attendance history/duration, assignment CRUD/confirmation, and delete cancellation. Retest duplicate Student ID, in-app student/subject confirmations, and calendar remount synchronization after fixes. Tablet render was covered by the prior iteration; this run's tablet checkpoint was skipped after a test harness request-payload error.
rca of the issue: Duplicate IDs are accepted because StudentsV2.commit() has no uniqueness check against state.students. Native confirmation occurs because the student and subject delete handlers directly call window.confirm, unlike AssignmentManager which renders confirm-box state. Calendar stale state is caused by CalendarV2 saveSession() calling setSessions() and PUT without updating App's shared state.
